description: This is a C# source file defining hosted service and grain classes for an Orleans application, implementing activation shedding and memory usage monitoring.

classes.name: ActivationSheddingToyHostedService
classes.description: A background service that periodically monitors and logs memory usage and activation counts within an Orleans cluster, and performs memory management and activation shedding logic.

classes.name: ActivationSheddingToyGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementation simulating activity and memory load, providing a Ping method.

classes.name: IActivationSheddingToyGrain
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for ActivationSheddingToyGrain, including a Ping method.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Main execution loop of the hosted service, performing memory checks, activation counting, and stats plotting.

methods.name: PrintUsage
methods.description: Outputs current memory and activation statistics, optionally forcing garbage collection.

methods.name: PlotAndPrintStats
methods.description: Computes and displays marginal memory usage per grain based on collected statistics.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Method to simulate activity in the grain, returning a completed task.
